$description: Typography, Today mode: what every role and exception renders in the default theme (the code renders exactly this). fontFamily and letterSpacing are inherited today (typography.config.json todayInherits), so they state the inherited defaults.

display.$description: The one statement a landing screen leads with; never more than one per screen.

title-page.$description: Names the whole screen the person is on (one per page; the h1).

title-section.$description: Names a region of a page that groups several cards, lists or blocks.

title-group.$description: Names one self-contained block: a card, a side panel, a dialog, a wizard step's field group.

title-item.$description: Names one item among peers in a list, table or grid.

body.$description: Running text a person reads in full on a page.

body-compact.$description: Running text inside a component that has little room: alert and dialog descriptions, help under a field.

supporting.$description: A short secondary line that qualifies a title or a value.

caption.$description: Small print nobody reads first: footnotes, counters, units, URLs under a link name, legal lines.

label.$description: Names a field the person fills in (form label, legend).

label-option.$description: Names one choice the person can pick (checkbox, radio, switch, toggle).

control.$description: Text inside an interactive control of the default size: buttons, tabs, menu and navigation items, typed text. Fixed.

control-sm.$description: The small step of control, for small controls (the step follows the control size, not the width). Fixed.

stat.$description: A headline figure in a summary, read at a glance and compared with its neighbours.

tooltip.$description: A short transient explanation that appears on hover or focus. Fixed.

supporting--inline-alert.$description: Inline alert message: the one-line message of an inline alert (validation and status under a field)

title-group--alert.$description: Alert card headline: the message line of an alert card (semibold through type-strong)

label-option--radio.$description: Radio label, fixed at the desktop size

title-item--compact-list.$description: Item titles in the asset transfer card (the asset and the two participants), one step down from the item title

supporting--row-value.$description: A row's value or status set as large as the row's title (asset amounts, transaction values, voting progress status, workspace and lock list values, governance body info)

stat--summary-card.$description: Summary card figure: CardSummary's value at page-title size

supporting--detail-value.$description: Secondary lines and values at 16/20 that keep one size: summary card description, wizard progress, fee rows, action detail values, transaction step labels, status messages

caption--footnote.$description: Footnotes set at the body size: data list counters and footer copyright lines

control--list-action.$description: Data list action row ("add" rows) that steps up on desktop like a list item

control--stepped-nav.$description: Breadcrumb text, which steps up on desktop where controls keep one size

control--tall-line.$description: Controls whose line box is the body line height (16 px / 1.5): multi-line fields, account and workspace picker rows, the landing link, the help center brand

supporting--body-size.$description: Secondary lines and values at the document default (16 px, line height 1.5) at every width (allowed-action contracts, profile address, dispatch panel values, vote dialog totals)

body--unstepped.$description: Body text that keeps the phone size (16 px, line height 1.5) on desktop: dialog and panel bodies, page and section descriptions, definition list values, the rich text editor, the landing page

caption--definition-description.$description: Secondary line under a definition list value

body-compact--unstepped.$description: Explanations in dialogs, panels and cards that keep the phone size on desktop

label-option--card.$description: Option card label (checkbox and radio cards), desktop line height left to the size default

supporting--compact-meta.$description: Secondary lines at 14/17.5 that keep one size: option card descriptions, voting stage labels, navigation group labels, picker and dialog details

label-option--toggle.$description: Toggle label at the body line height

caption--framework-leading.$description: Captions left at the sizes' default line heights (link URLs and descriptions, page header stat labels, the workspace switcher, voting terminal headings)

title-item--entity-list.$description: Main entity lists: the proposal, DAO and member list items name their entity at the group-title size

title-item--framework-leading.$description: Item titles left at the sizes' default line heights (voter rows, gauge rows, contract cards, policy details)

supporting--framework-leading.$description: Secondary and status lines left at the sizes' default line heights (vote amounts, simulation status, voting body brand, Safe review terms, lock list labels)

caption--compact-label.$description: Labels, counters and badges at 14 px that keep one size (stat card labels, step badges, the action position counter, chat markdown h6)

title-item--unstepped.$description: Item titles that keep the desktop size at every width (voting stages, DAO hierarchy, permission rows, strategy items)

title-group--voting-body.$description: Voting body name heading the body's panel, with default line heights

title-item--picker-row.$description: Item names in picker and function rows at a fixed size with the default line height (gauge and campaign pickers, dispatch routers, smart contract functions)

body-compact--component-note.$description: Short notes, errors and messages inside components at 14 px with the default line height (simulation and download errors, file notes, chat messages and tables, code blocks)

caption--list-date.$description: Dates in list rows, set at the supporting size (transaction rows)

title-section--inline-empty-state.$description: Empty-state title in the inline (not stacked) layout, one title step down

supporting--inline-empty-state.$description: Empty-state description in the inline layout, at caption size
